title: 第十一章 阵图第十二章 诛仙剑阵
content_zh:
“都是大姐教得好。大姐，我凝聚出第一道阵纹了，那接下来是要学习阵法，然后再凝聚阵印吗？”白宣期盼道。
“阵法是要学，而凝聚阵印，却不急。阵法布置需要借助各种媒介，故而过去阵师虽然作用很大，但地位远不如如今尊贵，直到阵印的出现，可以让阵师随处布阵，阵师的地位才大大提升。但阵印和阵印之间也是有区别的，一般来说阵师凝聚的第一道阵印，代表了他未来主修的阵道。”许玉华缓缓道。
世间阵法万千，哪怕只算攻击类型的阵法，都能分出杀阵、困阵、幻阵，而这三种阵法又能细分出无数种来，像杀戮，金木水火土都可以单独组成杀阵。
通常来说，阵法师最初学阵都是先广泛地学基础，然后专修一种，再等大成之后，学习其他。
毕竟人的精力是有限的。
而这第一道阵印的重要性也就在这里。
一般来说，大势力会根据修行者的资质，选择适合他的阵道修行，然后凝聚出相对应的阵印，然后不断学习高深阵法，是一整套系统的修行方式。
这里的条件太简陋了，没法做到这个。
得等白宣到镇北王府之后，才能继续。
“原来如此。”白宣点头，说起来，自己要主修什么阵法？
杀阵？
“三弟刚刚凝聚阵纹，也不适宜修炼太过复杂高深的阵法，可以从最简单的风水阵入手，夯实基础。”
许玉华说着话，站起身来，走入房内，从包袱之中，拿出一张上好的宣纸来，贴在桌上。
紧接着，许玉华眼中精芒流转，天地元气疯狂涌动，许玉华手中一个巴掌大小的阵印凝聚于虚空，然后落在宣纸之上，刻画出复杂的纹路，一道道线条交织，熠熠生辉，散发出光芒，令人目眩神迷。
白宣看到这一幕，面色微变，这纹路怎么感觉和他宝图当中的纹路有点像啊？
难不成他那宝图也是个阵图？
想到这里，白宣心中微微一凛，暗自留心，道：“大姐，这就是传说中的阵图吧，我听说强大的阵图价值连城，是无上珍宝。”
“没错，阵师是这个世界上最尊贵的身份，而阵图则是阵师最梦寐以求的东西，各大世家、宗门视之如命的底蕴所在。有没有高级的阵图，是衡量一个世家势力强弱的最高标准。不过我在上面刻画的阵法，只是最简单的风水阵，不值一提，也维持不了多久，过个五六日便会散去，到时我再给三弟画新的。”许玉华道。
“那高级的阵图是怎么样的？一出世，就绽放光华，阵纹繁琐？还有大姐，这天下最厉害的阵法是什么啊？我们镇北王府又有什么厉害的阵图？”白宣装作好奇地问道。
“高级阵图，首先刻画的阵法强大，这自不必多说，单单是这阵图的材质便不一样，可不像我用宣纸，没几天就消散，真正的高级阵图，都是能承载得起岁月的流逝，材质上多用九品妖兽的妖兽皮，少数甚至直接就是法器。”许玉华不疑有他，也乐于为白宣解惑。

“至于这天下最厉害的阵法，则无公论。尺有所短，寸有所长，阵法功效不同，有杀阵，有困阵，有幻阵，还有既是杀阵又是幻阵，本就难以评说。哪怕同为杀阵，这世间阵法虽有强弱之分，但更关键的还在于阵师的水平。便如我大周护国大阵山河社稷阵和北荒护国大阵的八荒囚龙阵数次交锋，各有胜负，看的便是阵师的高明。”
白宣闻言，心中微动，照这么说来，我怀中的宝图应该就是道门高人炼制的阵图，兼具法宝的效果，然后面上不做声色地笑道：“这么说来，是只有不厉害的阵师，没有不厉害的阵法？”
“同一档次的阵法，可以这么说。但也仅限是同一档次的阵法，比如这鸿运阵，哪怕是再厉害的阵师也不可能用这阵法击败完整的山河社稷阵。”许玉华道。
就好似武功一般，武学宗师武道高深，哪怕用最普通的五虎断门刀也能胜过那些修炼上乘刀法的宗门弟子，但倘若对方也是个武学宗师，那便不成了。
“那我镇北王府的最强的阵法是什么？”白宣问道。
“天枢荡魔阵，是父王当年追随先皇扫平诸侯之后，将攻破各大世家、宗门所获得的阵法搜集归纳，自创的阵法，以杀破狼三星为核心，诛仙荡魔，堪称当世第一杀阵。”许玉华语气颇为复杂道，以往提到这个阵法，她心里都是自豪，可如今阵法依旧在，她父王却不在了。
白宣心中异样，刚才说同一档次，阵无强弱，如今便说第一杀阵，不过他明智地没有反驳，毕竟这明显带着个人情绪，反驳了，不是给自己找不自在吗？
做学生，学知识，心里得有点数。
更别说咱还是报恩，得尊重人家。
所以白宣半是捧场，半是真心地赞道：“镇北王威压一世，果然名不虚传。”
哪怕许玉华的话有个人立场的因素干扰，但能让许玉华这么自豪，这天枢荡魔阵想来定是厉害至极。
镇北王能在前人的基础上，承前启后，创出这样的阵法。
绝对当得上传奇二字。
早知道的话，当初他来玉真观的时候，我直接把他打晕了，然后让他教我阵法了。
可惜了。
“天枢荡魔阵玄妙非常，我也不会，但三弟日后执掌镇北王府，非学不可，等日后返回镇北王府之后，请李师教导，想来以三弟的资质，练成不难。”许玉华道。
“仲父是什么境界的阵师？还有阵法、阵师有什么划分吗？”白宣问道。
“阵分五品，似鸿运阵这般简单的，基础阵，一阵印算初级灵阵，十印算中级灵阵，百印算高级灵阵，千印则算顶级灵阵，天枢荡魔阵便是当世顶级灵阵。
content_en:
"It's all thanks to my eldest sister's good teachings. Sister, I have condensed the first formation pattern. What is the next step for me to learn the formation and then condense the formation seal?" Bai Xuan said expectantly.
"Arrays need to be learned, but there is no rush to condense the formation seals. The arrangement of formations requires the use of various media. Therefore, although the formation master played a great role in the past, his status was far less noble than it is now. It was not until the emergence of formation seals that the formation master could set up formations anywhere, and the status of the formation master was greatly improved. But there is a difference between formation seals and formation seals. Generally speaking, the first formation seal condensed by the formation master represents the formation path he will major in in the future." Xu Yuhua said slowly.
There are thousands of formations in the world, even if they only count the attack type formations, they can be divided into killing formations, trapping formations, and phantom formations, and these three formations can be subdivided into countless types. For example, killing formations, metal, wood, water, fire, and earth can all individually form killing formations.
Generally speaking, formation masters first learn the basics of formations broadly, then specialize in one type, and then learn others after they have mastered the formation.
After all, human energy is limited.
And this is the importance of this first formation seal.
Generally speaking, the big forces will choose the formation practice suitable for the practitioner based on his qualifications, and then condense the corresponding formation seals, and then continue to learn advanced formations, which is a complete set of systematic practice methods.
The conditions here are too crude to do this.
You have to wait until Bai Xuan arrives at Zhenbei Palace before you can continue.
"I see." Bai Xuan nodded, speaking of which formation he wanted to major in?
Killing array?
"Third brother has just condensed the formation patterns, and it is not suitable to practice too complex and advanced formations. You can start with the simplest Feng Shui formation to lay a solid foundation."
As Xu Yuhua spoke, she stood up, walked into the room, took out a piece of good rice paper from the bag, and put it on the table.
Immediately afterwards, Xu Yuhua's eyes flashed with light, and the energy of heaven and earth surged crazily. A palm-sized formation seal in Xu Yuhua's hand condensed in the void, and then fell on the rice paper, depicting complex lines. The lines were intertwined, shining and emitting light, which was dazzling.
Bai Xuan's expression changed slightly when he saw this scene. Why do these lines feel a bit similar to the lines in his treasure map?
Could it be that his treasure map is also a formation map?
Thinking of this, Bai Xuan's heart trembled slightly, and he paid attention secretly and said: "Sister, this is the legendary formation diagram. I heard that the powerful formation diagram is priceless and is a supreme treasure."
"Yes, the formation master is the most noble status in the world, and the formation map is the most coveted thing of the formation master. It is the foundation that major families and sects regard as their destiny. Whether there is a high-level formation map is a measure of the power of a family. The highest standard of strength. However, the formation I drew above is just the simplest Feng Shui formation. It is not worth mentioning and will not last long. It will disappear in five or six days. Then I will draw a new one for my third brother.
"What are the advanced formations like? They bloom with brilliance as soon as they are born, but the formations are complicated? And eldest sister, what is the most powerful formation in the world? What powerful formations does our Zhenbei Palace have?" Bai Xuan asked pretending to be curious.
"Advanced formation diagrams, first of all, the formations depicted are powerful. Needless to say, the material of this formation diagram is different. It is not like the rice paper I used, which dissipated in a few days. The real advanced formation diagrams can withstand the passage of time. The materials are mostly the skins of ninth-grade monsters, and a few are even magic weapons." Xu Yuhua did not doubt that he was there, and was happy to explain Bai Xuan's doubts.
"As for the most powerful formation in the world, there is no consensus. A foot is shorter than an inch, and an inch is longer. The effectiveness of the formations is different. There are killing formations, trapping formations, illusory formations, and there are both killing formations and illusory formations. It is difficult to comment. Even if they are both killing formations, although there are strong and weak formations in this world, the more important thing lies in the level of the formation masters. Just like the Shanhe Sheji Formation of our Great Zhou National Defense Formation and the Eight Desolate Prisoner Dragon Formation of the Northern Wilderness Protective Formation.Each has its own victory or defeat, and it all depends on the skill of the formation master. "
When Bai Xuan heard this, his heart moved slightly. According to this, the treasure map in my arms should be a formation map refined by a Taoist master, which also has the effect of a magic weapon. Then he smiled calmly on his face and said: "So, there are only bad formation masters, and there are no bad formations? "
"The same level of formation, so to speak. But it is limited to formations of the same level, such as the Fortune Formation. No matter how powerful the formation master is, it is impossible to defeat the complete Shanhe Sheji Formation with this formation. "Xu Yuhua said.
Just like martial arts, a martial arts master is very advanced in martial arts. Even with the most ordinary Five Tigers Broken Gate Sword, he can defeat those sect disciples who practice superior sword skills. But if the other party is also a martial arts master, it will not be possible.
"Then what is the strongest formation in our Zhenbei Palace? "Bai Xuan asked.
"The Tianshu Demon Array is a self-created array created by my father after he followed the late emperor to wipe out the princes and defeated the major families and sects. With the three stars of killing wolves as the core, it can be called the best killing array in the world. "Xu Yuhua said in a rather complicated tone. In the past, when she mentioned this formation, she felt proud in her heart, but now the formation is still there, but her father is no longer there.
Bai Xuan felt strange in his heart. He had just said that the formations were of the same level and had no strength, and now he was talking about the first killing formation. However, he wisely did not refute. After all, this was obviously based on personal emotions. If he refuted it, wouldn't he make himself uncomfortable?
To be a student and learn knowledge, you have to know something in your mind.
Not to mention that we should repay the favor and respect others.
Therefore, Bai Xuan half cheered and half sincerely praised: "The king of Zhenbei is so powerful that he truly deserves his reputation. "
Even if Xu Yuhua's words were interfered with by his personal position, to make Xu Yuhua so proud, this Tianshu Dang Demonic Array must be extremely powerful.
King Zhenbei was able to create such a formation on the basis of his predecessors, inheriting the past and linking up with the future.
Definitely worthy of being called a legend.
If I had known earlier, when he came to Yuzhen Temple, I knocked him unconscious and asked him to teach me the formation.
What a pity.
"The Tianshu Demonic Formation is very mysterious, and I don't know how to do it, but my third brother will be in charge of the Zhenbei Palace in the future, so he has to learn it. When he returns to the Zhenbei Palace in the future, he will ask Master Li to teach him. I think with my third brother's qualifications, it will not be difficult to master it. "Xu Yuhua said.
"What level of formation master is Father Zhong? Are there any divisions between formations and formation masters? "Bai Xuan asked.
"The formation is divided into five levels, as simple as the Fortune Formation, the basic formation, one seal is the elementary spiritual formation, ten seals is the intermediate spiritual formation, one hundred seals is the advanced spiritual formation, one thousand seals is the top spiritual formation, and Tianshu Dang Demon Formation is the top spiritual formation in the world.
